nace_r2.label: Statistical classification of economic activities in the European Community (NACE Rev. 2)

label.H-N_STS: Services required by STS regulation (except section G)
label.H-N_X_K: Services of the business economy (except trade and financial and insurance activities)
label.H49: Land transport and transport via pipelines
label.H494-N812_STS: Services required by STS regulation (for the service producer prices indicator)
label.H494: Freight transport by road and removal services
label.H52: Warehousing and support activities for transportation
label.H531: Postal activities under universal service obligation
label.J59: Motion picture, video and television programme production, sound recording and music publishing activities
label.J62_J63: Computer programming, consultancy, and information service activities
label.J62: Computer programming, consultancy and related activities
label.J631: Data processing, hosting and related activities; web portals
label.M_STS: Professional, scientific and technical activities required by STS regulation
label.M69_M702: Legal, accounting and management consultancy activities
label.M692: Accounting, bookkeeping and auditing activities; tax consultancy
label.M71: Architectural and engineering activities; technical testing and analysis
label.M74: Other professional, scientific and technical activities
label.N79: Travel agency, tour operator and other reservation service and related activities
label.N81: Services to buildings and landscape activities
label.N82: Office administrative, office support and other business support activities

label.NSA: Unadjusted data (i.e. neither seasonally adjusted nor calendar adjusted data)

label.PCH_SM: Percentage change compared to same period in previous year

label.i: value imputed by Eurostat or other receiving agencies
